overview_description.description: BuildScience is a team of University of Waterloo Engineering alumni with a passion for cutting-edge technology. Having worked at Fortune 500 companies, startups and institutions, they understand that tackling the challenges faced by today's buildings requires a diverse team. Over the years they've gained extensive experience working with hardware, software and power systems. They’ve built data-driven analytics that shaped display technology, designed a meteorological station that landed on Mars, and improved electricity system reliability.
